entities.name: János Frivaldszky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Frivaldszky was a Hungarian entomologist and ornithologist. Nephew of Imre Frivaldszky, he succeeded him at the Hungarian Natural History Museum. He sometimes used the German form Johannes or Latin form Joannes in his writings.
